answer: Dwell-time attention escrow. An identity mints free but earns its first whisper of reputation only through verified dwell time. Prompt timing is a gale, not a metronome: unpredictable bursts over 72 hours defeat batching and scripting. Because the schedule cannot be compressed, a farm must hold each account open in real time. Unanswered prompts decay, and a knoll of parked identities rots to zero in days. Attacker cost: idle human-hours per identity per day, linear in identity count, with no capital shortcut.
